cohort: Nulliparous, term, singleton live births in California
finding: Despite a substantial decrease in cesarean delivery rates for White birthing people, racial disparities in cesarean delivery rates and indications persisted between Black and White birthing people in California from 2011 to 2017.
mod_finding: This study found that Black birthing people had a persistently higher risk of cesarean delivery than White birthing people, even after controlling for confounders.
